cards.card_text: Then the LORD covers the cooking options: baked in an oven, made on a griddle or cooked in a pan.
cards.verse_text: If your offering is a grain offering prepared on a griddle, it must be unleavened bread made of fine flour mixed with oil.

cards.card_text: Fine flour, oil, a griddle, well-kneaded, broken in pieces: friend, NOW you're speaking my language.
cards.verse_text: It shall be prepared with oil on a griddle; you are to bring it well-kneaded and present it as a grain offering broken in pieces, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

cards.card_text: The hide of a burnt offering goes to the priest who presents it, and so does any grain offering baked in an oven or cooked in a pan or on a griddle, while every grain offering that's dry or mixed with oil belongs equally to all the sons of Aaron.
cards.verse_text: Likewise, every grain offering that is baked in an oven or cooked in a pan or on a griddle belongs to the priest who presents it, and every grain offering, whether dry or mixed with oil, belongs equally to all the sons of Aaron.
